summary: Aspect C (reasoning procedure): xac02 with judgement.md replaced by an anchor-and-adjust procedure that starts p_ischemic from the size of the change in literature bands (100/150/200 uV, ACC/AHA, K17, K26), adjusts it with bounded two-way card-cited items (timing K01/K02, steady rate K29/K08, shape K24-K26, synchronous QRS/ST steps K14/K27/K36, slow-rate elevation K32, rise size K04), and counts as non-evidence the rate_response 'beyond usual' finding that nearly every candidate shows, with the matching heart-rate line of the usage guidance.
